tool_args.rationale: Use the verified normalized contrast law y = gain*(u_now-u_past)*exp(-H/tau_relax) + k_eq*u_now. Fit its three parameters numerically from the five varied observations. The earlier execution error was an interface bug (predict attempted to read a nonexistent _train_rows field); this implementation stores fitted parameters in fit and predicts directly from each row.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observed opposing-step signature and existing varied before/after and horizon rows identify the three-parameter law; trajectory data is aimed at a different coupled-memory ODE.

considered_alternatives.option: Static linear or static snapshot model
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Rows include opposite-sign responses to upward versus downward steps, inconsistent with a static dependence on u_now alone.
The supplied signature and archive mechanism specifically support normalized before/after relaxation; no long-horizon reversal evidence justifies additional horizon sampling.
